read-ai-vs-otter-ai.9: There is a similar jump on the other side. The Enterprise tier, which is the one you need for audio and video playback, costs $22.50 to $29.75 per user and requires 5 licenses, so a team of 3 still pays for 5 seats. Same story both ways.
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.11: Say you run a single weekly hour-long client call. Read AI Free covers it. Otter Free cuts each call in half, which leaves you with notes for the first 30 minutes and nothing for the decisions made at the end.
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.16: Premium integrations come with Read AI Pro, 7 of them: Notion, Confluence, Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Zapier and webhooks. On Otter, Pro adds Salesforce, HubSpot and Zapier. API access and webhooks wait until Enterprise.
read-ai-vs-otter-ai.17: Product teams get a slight edge from Read AI's Jira and Confluence connections. Large sales teams may lean the other way. Why? Because Otter's Enterprise plan adds custom CRM and dialer integrations and an Otter Sales Notetaker, which together cover most of what a big sales floor asks for.
